_comment: Emblems (114). A walker whose minus gives a target opponent Ob Nixilis Reignited's emblem and takes its last loyalty doing it, and whose plus gives its own controller the same emblem -- so 'you' on the emblem is measured against both seats.

cards.name: Test Emblem Walker
cards.oracle_text:
+1: You get an emblem with "Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life."
−3: Target opponent gets an emblem with "Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life."
